title: Chandan Lal @ Chandan Kumar v. U.P. Power Corporation Limited And 3 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Final assessment quashed; fresh Supply Code order left open.
headnote: Final assessment of electricity dues in a theft case quashed where the provisional assessment notice fixed no date of hearing and the objection filed was not considered. Liberty reserved to pass a fresh order strictly under the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Writ disposed of.
facts: Chandan Lal alias Chandan Kumar challenged orders of respondent no. 2 dated 10 January 2022 and 18 June 2022, and a recovery citation dated 25 February 2023 issued by respondent no. 4, for dues in an electricity-theft case. A provisional assessment notice dated 17 December 2021, served on 25 December 2021, fixed no date of hearing. He filed objections on 8 January 2022. Without dealing with them, the respondents passed a final assessment on 10 January 2022 and issued the citation. Departmental counsel could not defend the order and sought liberty to decide afresh.

reusable_constructions.construction: A final assessment in an electricity-theft case cannot stand where the provisional assessment notice fixes no date of hearing and the objection filed is not considered; the licensee may pass a fresh order only by following the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: final assessment in a theft case without a hearing date or consideration of the objection
holding_units.holding: Where the provisional assessment notice in a theft case fixes no date of hearing and the final assessment is passed without considering the objection, the final assessment is quashed, leaving the licensee to pass a fresh order strictly in accordance with the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
